required.quote: each person licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist or registered as a dental assistant is required to attend and complete during each two-year cycle, except for the two-year cycle of initial licensure, the number of hours of board approved continuing education courses that are prescribed by the board, subject to a minimum of twenty-four (24) and a maximum of sixty (60) clock hours

available.quote: Such registered and/or practical dental assistants may practice as authorized in this section or § 63-5-108 only in the office of and under the direct supervision of a licensed and registered dentist except in authorized public health programs.

exists.quote: The practice of dentistry and of dental hygiene shall be under the direct supervision of a board to be known as the board of dentistry

credential_type.quote: to register dental assistants who meet such standards of competency as the board may require by rules and regulations

is_mandatory.quote: Such registered and/or practical dental assistants may practice as authorized in this section or § 63-5-108 only in the office of and under the direct supervision of a licensed and registered dentist except in authorized public health programs. No provisions in this chapter shall be construed as authorizing any licensed and registered dental hygienists, registered dental assistants or practical dental assistants to practice as such except as provided in this section.

title_protection.quote: Conduct hearings to revoke, suspend or otherwise lawfully discipline the holder of any license or certificate issued under the authority of this chapter or any previous laws authorizing the holder thereof to practice dentistry, a specialty in dentistry, dental hygiene or as a certified and/or registered dental assistant

scope_protection.quote: No provisions in this chapter shall be construed as authorizing any licensed and registered dental hygienists, registered dental assistants or practical dental assistants to practice as such except as provided in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of this chapter or any lawful board order or criminal statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation or attempted violation, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, this chapter or any lawful order of the board issued pursuant thereto or any criminal statute of this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements or fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in practice as a registered dental assistant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false or misleading statements or representations, being guilty of fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in being guilty of fraud or deceit in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene or as a registered dental assistant;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross health care liability or pattern of negligence or incompetence in professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of professional practice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or misuse of drugs adversely affecting ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs or the use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics, controlled substances, controlled substance analogues or other drugs or stimulants, such as, but not limited to, nitrous oxide sedation, in such manner as to adversely affect the person's ability to practice dentistry, dental hygiene or as a registered dental assistant;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, drug offense, or offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of any offense under state or federal drug laws, or conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or signing a certificate known to be false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time one makes or signs such certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing or distributing controlled substances not in the course of professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance or any other drug not in the course of professional practice, or not in good faith to relieve pain and suffering or not to cure an ailment, physical infirmity or disease;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in practice as a registered dental assistant when mentally or physically unable to safely do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene or as a registered dental assistant when mentally or physically unable to safely do so;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed person to perform services that can only be done by licensed persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting the practice of dentistry so as to permit directly or indirectly an unlicensed person to perform services or work that under this chapter can be done legally only by persons licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or as a registered dental assistant;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state for acts that would constitute grounds for discipline in Tennessee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against a person licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or registered to practice as a dental assistant by another state or territory of the United States for any acts or omissions that would constitute grounds for discipline of a person licensed or registered in this state.

definition_quote.value: Any duly licensed and registered dentist may assign to duly licensed and registered dental hygienists, registered dental assistants and/or practical dental assistants, as defined by the board in rules and regulations, any tasks or procedures to be performed in the dentist's office for which a licensed and registered dentist exercises direct supervision and full responsibility, except those procedures requiring the professional judgment or skill of a dentist
definition_quote.quote: Any duly licensed and registered dentist may assign to duly licensed and registered dental hygienists, registered dental assistants and/or practical dental assistants, as defined by the board in rules and regulations, any tasks or procedures to be performed in the dentist's office for which a licensed and registered dentist exercises direct supervision and full responsibility, except those procedures requiring the professional judgment or skill of a dentist

value: Delegated tasks and procedures under direct supervision of a licensed dentist
Polishing of human teeth (board authorized, requires clinical and didactic exam)
Insertion, packing, carving and finishing amalgam and intracoronal nonmetallic restorations (board authorized, under direct supervision)
Taking final impressions for fixed and removable prosthetic appliances (board authorized, under direct supervision)
Participation unsupervised in educational functions regarding preventive oral health care
Taking impressions under direct supervision of a licensed dentist (for dental laboratory work)
methods_authorized.quote: The board has the authority to permit registered dental assistants to apply sealants to and to polish human teeth, and the board has the discretion to establish criteria and curricula as necessary to ensure that such registered dental assistants are qualified to apply sealants and perform polishing. For eligibility to perform polishing, passage of a clinical and didactic examination is required. The board is authorized to permit licensed and registered dental hygienists and registered dental assistants to insert, pack, carve and finish amalgam and intracoronal nonmetallic restorations and take final impressions for fixed and removable prosthetic appliances, under the direct supervision and full responsibility of a licensed dentist

drug_authority.value: Dental assistants have no independent drug prescribing authority; topical anesthetic may be used in connection with dental operations only as delegated
drug_authority.quote: Administration of a general or local anesthetic, except for a topical anesthetic in connection with a dental operation

value: Oral surgery and cutting of hard and/or soft tissues
Placing of permanent fillings or restorations in or on teeth (except as specifically authorized)
Administration of general or local anesthetic (except topical anesthetic)
Removal of hard and soft deposits by scaling or curettage from surfaces of human teeth (reserved for dental hygienists only)
prohibited_procedures.quote: Procedures requiring professional judgment or skill not assignable to such dental hygienists and dental assistants include the following: Diagnosis and treatment planning; oral surgery, the cutting of hard and/or soft tissues... The placing of permanent fillings or restorations in or on teeth except as provided in this subsection (d); and Administration of a general or local anesthetic, except for a topical anesthetic

teledentistry_scope_limitations.value: Teledentistry does not alter or amend supervision requirements for registered dental assistants; they may only perform services authorized during an in-person patient encounter under direct supervision
teledentistry_scope_limitations.quote: Teledentistry shall not alter or amend the supervision requirements or procedures authorized for licensed and registered dental hygienists or registered dental assistants.
